rationale: Round, interpretable PoC thresholds selected as initial rules, not fitted to the 24-episode label counts or outcomes. Any change requires a new config version.
minimum_sample_note: The 24-episode dry run validates implementation and availability only. Do not compare outcomes. Exploratory rates require at least 100 labeled and 100 control episodes; confirmatory analysis requires at least 500 total episodes, at least 50 per tested label-side cell, and a held-out time period.
overlap_policy: Labels are non-exclusive. FOMO and LATE may both be TRUE; market and episode-sequence labels may coexist.
unavailable_policy: A missing required feature yields UNAVAILABLE, never FALSE and never numeric zero.
